title: ¿Me ayuda?
subtitle: Asking for help at a pharmacy
scene: You woke up feeling awful. There’s a pharmacy on the corner.

lines.en: Excuse me, can you help me, please?
Of course. What do you need?

lines.es: Me siento mal. Me duele el estómago.
lines.en: I feel sick. My stomach hurts.
lines.note: Me duele… = my … hurts. Me duele la cabeza = my head hurts.

lines.es: Tome esto. Una pastilla cada ocho horas.
lines.en: Take this. One pill every eight hours.

lines.es: Si tiene fiebre, sí. Hay un consultorio aquí al lado.
lines.en: If you have a fever, yes. There’s a doctor’s office right next door.

culture.title: Pharmacies
culture.text: Many Mexican pharmacies have a small doctor’s office next door (consultorio) with quick, cheap visits. In an emergency, call 911.

lines.en: Thank you so much. Very kind!
